questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: The acceleration due to gravity (g) at the center of the Earth is equal to:
questions.explanation: Acceleration due to gravity varies as g' = g(1 - d/R). At the earth's center depth d = R, so g' = 0.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: Heat transfer without requiring any intervening medium takes place through:
questions.explanation: Radiation transfers energy through electromagnetic waves and does not require a material medium.
questions.ncertReference: Physics Class 11, Chapter 11: Thermal Properties of Matter

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.topic: Organic Chemistry - Basic Principles and Techniques
questions.question: Which functional group shows the highest priority according to IUPAC nomenclature rules?
questions.explanation: Carboxylic acids (-COOH) have the highest priority among the listed functional groups.
questions.ncertReference: Chemistry Class 11, Chapter 12: Organic Chemistry - Basic Principles

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.topic: Organic Chemistry - Basic Principles and Techniques
questions.question: Two compounds having the same molecular formula but different carbon chain skeletons exhibit:
questions.explanation: Chain isomerism occurs when compounds have identical molecular formulas but different arrangements of the carbon skeleton.
questions.ncertReference: Chemistry Class 11, Chapter 12: Organic Chemistry - Basic Principles

questions.subject: Botany
questions.question: Casparian strips are impermeable water-proof bands found in which tissue layer of roots?
questions.explanation: Endodermal cells have tangential and radial walls deposited with suberin forming water-impermeable Casparian strips.
questions.ncertReference: Biology Class 11, Chapter 6: Anatomy of Flowering Plants

questions.subject: Botany
questions.question: Which cell organelle is known as the 'suicide bag' of the cell?
questions.explanation: Lysosomes contain hydrolytic digestive enzymes capable of breaking down cellular components during autolysis.
questions.ncertReference: Biology Class 11, Chapter 8: Cell: The Unit of Life

questions.subject: Zoology
questions.question: Which bond links individual amino acids together to form a primary protein structure?
questions.explanation: Amino acids are linked covalently by peptide bonds (-CO-NH-) formed by condensation.

questions.subject: Zoology
questions.question: What is the primary structural and functional unit of the human kidney?
questions.explanation: Each human kidney contains roughly 1 million functional tubular structures called nephrons.
questions.ncertReference: Biology Class 11, Chapter 19: Excretory Products and their Elimination

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: In an isothermal process, which property of the system remains constant throughout?
questions.explanation: An isothermal process is a thermodynamic transformation occurring at constant system temperature (ΔT = 0).

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: The orientation of an atomic orbital in space is determined by which quantum number?
questions.explanation: The magnetic quantum number (m_l) defines spatial orientation of an orbital relative to axes.
questions.ncertReference: Chemistry Class 11, Chapter 2: Structure of Atom
